title: rtcompass
description: Adds a configurable HUD Compass inspired by the game Squad
body:
Adds a configurable HUD Compass inspired by the game Squad.
![Hud compass in Hotbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e85dede89582a08ba5ee7d1037424546a9403bf4.png)
It is possible to change the colors, scale, position, and width.

Copyright only prohibits you from claiming a mod as your own and selling it
